patch_description:
Reverting to the modular ansatz structure from the best-performing prior program (score 0.89, 128 params) and applying the recommended refinement: instead of a single shared parameter for all skip-2 edges and all skip-3 edges, alternate between two shared parameters (even/odd indexed edges) for each skip distance. This mirrors the proven alternating-strength motif already used successfully in the ring layer, giving finer-grained control over long-range entanglement strength while only adding 2 extra parameters (4 total instead of 2 for skip layers). This should tighten mid-range mixing and potentially reduce the generalization gap while keeping parameter count modest (132 vs 128).

The current file (with rz_pre/rz_post ansatz, 176 params, score 0.86) is replaced wholesale with the better modular structure plus this refinement.
